name: persona-live-activity
description: scripts/app/sim-boot.sh --profile live-activity (simslim v0.14.0, iOS 27.0): the default profile plus store (App Store, Push & Media), for Live Activity work that goes through real APNs: push-to-start and update tokens, TestManualLiveActivityPush. The default profile already keeps widgets (chronod, liveactivitiesd), linkd and apsd, which LiveActivityActionTests / LiveActivityShots need; measured on iOS 27.0, turning widgets off saved nothing (2.34 GB / 86 processes with it, 2.77 GB / 88 without), so default keeps it.
